result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is added as a second name for `updateLandscape`. The module compiles offline, but I could not run the CLI, so the runtime behaviour and `-help` output are unverified. My attempts to run `java` were blocked by the permission system.

What changed (nothing committed):

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: new `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` constant and description ("...The landscape counterpart of the analysis commands, same as updateLandscape"). It is listed in the no-argument usage overview next to `updateLandscape`, which stays.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**:
  - `run` dispatches both names to `updateLandscape(args)`, so options and behaviour are shared.
  - `updateLandscape`'s `-help` branch prints the usage under the name the user typed, with the matching description.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no per-command descriptions and never mentioned `updateLandscape`, so I added a short "Landscape" section describing both names and a usage example.

To verify, run `java -jar sokrates.jar analyzeLandscape -help`, `updateLandscape -help`, and `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` against a scratch folder. I also left a classpath file at `/tmp/sokrates-cli-cp.txt` from the attempt; it is outside the repo and safe to delete.
